evals.name: migration-auto-generate
evals.prompt: I added a new field `phone_number = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True)` to my Django Customer model in `apps/customers/models.py`. Write the migration file for this change. The project uses Django 6.0 and has `manage.py` in the root.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs `python manage.py makemigrations` to auto-generate the migration instead of writing it by hand

evals.name: ruff-before-manual-cleanup
evals.prompt: I just added a new view to my Django project. The file has unused imports, wrong import order, and some formatting issues. Fix the lint issues in `apps/orders/views.py`.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs `ruff check --fix && ruff format` before any manual lint fixes

evals.name: select-related-n-plus-one
evals.prompt: Write a Django view that lists all orders with the customer's email address. The Order model has a ForeignKey to Customer, and Customer has an `email` field. Put it in `apps/orders/views.py`.
evals.expected_output: Agent uses `.select_related('customer')` in the queryset to prevent N+1 queries

evals.name: manual-migration-only-for-runpython
evals.prompt: I need to write a Django migration that backfills a new `full_name` field by concatenating `first_name` and `last_name` for all existing User records. The project has `manage.py` in the root.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs `makemigrations` first to generate the skeleton, then adds RunPython to the generated file — does not write the entire migration by hand
